# nti-leaderboard: Verifiable AI Agent Security Benchmarks

> This repository is the public compliance leaderboard for the NTI ecosystem. It ranks AI agent frameworks based on cryptographically signed security attestations from the nti-registry. It solves the problem of fake self-reported security scores by requiring offline-verifiable proof.

Directory structure:
└── app/
    ├── README.md
    ├── AGENTS.md
    ├── eslint.config.mjs
    ├── LICENSE
    ├── next.config.ts
    ├── package.json
    ├── tsconfig.json
    ├── vercel.json
    └── src/
        ├── app/
        │   ├── globals.css
        │   ├── layout.tsx
        │   └── page.tsx
        ├── components/
        │   ├── LeaderboardTable.tsx
        │   ├── ReproducibilityEngine.tsx
        │   └── VerificationModal.tsx
        ├── data/
        │   └── leaderboard.json
        └── types/
            └── leaderboard.ts

================================================
FILE: README.md
================================================
# nti-leaderboard

Cryptographically verifiable compliance leaderboard for AI agent frameworks.

```mermaid
graph TD
    UserRepo[User GitHub Repo] -->|Run scan| NtiAction[nti-scan-action]
    NtiAction -->|Cryptographic Attestation| NtiRegistry[nti-registry]
    NtiRegistry -->|Sync Evidence| LeaderboardJson[leaderboard.json]
    LeaderboardJson -->|Static Source of Truth| NextApp[Next.js Leaderboard App]
```

## Overview

`nti-leaderboard` is the definitive public benchmark for AI Agent Security. It solves the problem of fake, self-reported security scores by demanding cryptographic proof via AST static analysis and post-quantum attestations.

## Quick Start

Run a local verification scan using `nti-scanner`:

```bash
pip install nti-scanner
nti-scanner scan . --submit
```

## Features

- **Enterprise Schema:** Static JSON source of truth (`src/data/leaderboard.json`) backed by `NTI-Registry`.
- **Cryptographic Attestations:** Post-quantum signatures (`ML-DSA-5`) and SHA-256 attestation hashes.
- **Deep Tech UI:** Pure dark mode glassmorphism UI with expandable AST findings.
- **Reproducibility Engine:** Self-service verification instructions.

## License

[Apache 2.0](LICENSE)

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Geist, Geist_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import "./globals.css";

const geistSans = Geist({
  variable: "--font-geist-sans",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

const geistMono = Geist_Mono({
  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Create Next App",
  description: "Generated by create next app",
};

export default function RootLayout({ children }: LayoutProps<"/">) {
  return (
    <html
      lang="en"
      className={`${geistSans.variable} ${geistMono.variable} h-full antialiased`}
    >
      <body className="min-h-full flex flex-col">{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}

import leaderboardDataRaw from "@/data/leaderboard.json";
import { LeaderboardTable } from "@/components/LeaderboardTable";
import { ReproducibilityEngine } from "@/components/ReproducibilityEngine";
import { LeaderboardData } from "@/types/leaderboard";
import { ArrowUpRight, Shield, Zap } from "lucide-react";

const leaderboardData = leaderboardDataRaw as LeaderboardData;

export default function Home() {
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#050505] text-white selection:bg-emerald-500/30 selection:text-emerald-200 relative overflow-hidden font-sans pb-24">
      {/* Background Gradients */}
      <div className="fixed top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[1000px] h-[500px] bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-500/10 via-cyan-500/5 to-transparent blur-3xl pointer-events-none -z-10" />

      {/* Top Navigation */}
      <header className="border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-40">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400">
              <Shield className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold tracking-wider text-sm text-white">
                NTI LEADERBOARD
              </span>
              <span className="ml-2.5 text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                {leaderboardData.rubricVersion}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <a
            href="https://github.com/marketplace"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white text-black font-semibold text-xs hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-white/10"
          >
            <span>Get Your Framework Scored</span>
            <ArrowUpRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </a>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Hero Section */}
      <section className="pt-20 pb-12 max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 text-center">
        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/10 text-zinc-300 text-xs font-mono mb-6">
          <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
          <span>Post-Quantum ML-DSA-5 Verified Benchmarks</span>
        </div>

        <h1 className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white max-w-4xl mx-auto leading-[1.1]">
          The Standard for{" "}
          <span className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 via-teal-300 to-cyan-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
            AI Agent Security
          </span>
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-6 text-zinc-400 text-base sm:text-lg max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
          The definitive public benchmark for AI Agent security. Eliminating
          self-reported scores with offline-verifiable post-quantum security attestations.
        </p>
      </section>

      {/* Leaderboard Table */}
      <section className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 mt-6">
        <LeaderboardTable entries={leaderboardData.entries} />
      </section>

      {/* Reproducibility Section */}
      <ReproducibilityEngine />

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="mt-24 border-t border-white/5 pt-8 text-center font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500">
        <p>
          Generated at {leaderboardData.generatedAt} • Source: {leaderboardData.source} • Rubric: {leaderboardData.rubricVersion}
        </p>
      </footer>
    </main>
  );
}



================================================
FILE: src/components/LeaderboardTable.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertTriangle,
  AlertOctagon,
  Info,
  CheckCircle2,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  Minus,
} from "lucide-react";
import { LeaderboardEntry, Severity, Status } from "@/types/leaderboard";
import { VerificationModal } from "./VerificationModal";

interface LeaderboardTableProps {
  entries: LeaderboardEntry[];
}

export const LeaderboardTable: React.FC<LeaderboardTableProps> = ({ entries }) => {
  const [expandedRow, setExpandedRow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedVerification, setSelectedVerification] = useState<{
    name: string;
    evidence: LeaderboardEntry["evidence"];
  } | null>(null);

  const toggleExpand = (slug: string) => {
    setExpandedRow((prev) => (prev === slug ? null : slug));
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: Status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "Verified":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-emerald-400/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
            Verified
          </span>
        );
      case "Pending":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-amber-400/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400" />
            Pending
          </span>
        );
      case "Failing":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-rose-400/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-400" />
            Failing
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  const getSeverityBadge = (severity: Severity) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case "Critical":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30">
            <AlertOctagon className="w-3 h-3" />
            Critical
          </span>
        );
      case "High":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />
            High
          </span>
        );
      case "Moderate":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />
            Moderate
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30">
            <Info className="w-3 h-3" />
            {severity}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-white/[0.08] text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              <th className="py-4 px-6 w-16">Rank</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6">Framework</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center">Score</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center">Grade</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center">Status</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center">Trend</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6 text-right">Last Scanned</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center">Verification</th>
              <th className="py-4 px-6 w-12"></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/[0.05] text-sm">
            {entries.map((entry) => {
              const isExpanded = expandedRow === entry.slug;

              return (
                <React.Fragment key={entry.slug}>
                  <tr
                    onClick={() => toggleExpand(entry.slug)}
                    className={`group cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isExpanded ? "bg-white/[0.06]" : "hover:bg-white/[0.04]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Rank */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 font-mono text-zinc-400 font-bold">
                      #{entry.rank}
                    </td>

                    {/* Name */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-white group-hover:text-emerald-300 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
                        {entry.name}
                        {entry.findings.length > 0 && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                            {entry.findings.length} findings
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                        {entry.slug}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Score */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center">
                      <span
                        className={`font-mono font-bold text-lg ${
                          entry.score >= 90
                            ? "text-emerald-400"
                            : entry.score >= 50
                            ? "text-amber-400"
                            : "text-rose-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {entry.score}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Grade */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center">
                      <span
                        className={`font-mono font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs border ${
                          entry.grade.startsWith("A")
                            ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30"
                            : "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {entry.grade}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Status */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center">
                      {getStatusBadge(entry.status)}
                    </td>

                    {/* Trend */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center font-mono text-xs">
                      {entry.trend ? (
                        <div
                          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold ${
                            entry.trend.delta > 0
                              ? "text-emerald-400"
                              : entry.trend.delta < 0
                              ? "text-rose-400"
                              : "text-zinc-400"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {entry.trend.delta > 0 ? (
                            <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          ) : (
                            <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          )}
                          {entry.trend.delta > 0 ? `+${entry.trend.delta}` : entry.trend.delta}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="inline-flex items-center text-zinc-600">
                          <Minus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Last Scanned */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-right font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400">
                      {entry.lastScanned}
                    </td>

                    {/* Verification Action */}
                    <td
                      className="py-4 px-6 text-center"
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                    >
                      <button
                        onClick={() =>
                          setSelectedVerification({
                            name: entry.name,
                            evidence: entry.evidence,
                          })
                        }
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-medium text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-400/10 hover:bg-emerald-400/20 border border-emerald-500/30 transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-emerald-500/10"
                      >
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        Verify
                      </button>
                    </td>

                    {/* Expand Toggle */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center text-zinc-500 hover:text-white transition-colors">
                      {isExpanded ? (
                        <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />
                      ) : (
                        <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>

                  {/* Expanded AST Findings Drawer */}
                  {isExpanded && (
                    <tr className="bg-black/40 border-b border-white/[0.08]">
                      <td colSpan={9} className="p-6">
                        <div className="space-y-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/5">
                            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span>AST Vulnerability Findings</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-normal">
                                (Engine: {entry.evidence.scannerVersion})
                              </span>
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          {entry.findings.length === 0 ? (
                            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/10 flex items-center gap-3">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                              <div className="text-xs text-emerald-300 font-sans">
                                No AST vulnerabilities detected. 100% compliant with NTI-1.0 security rubric.
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="space-y-2">
                              {entry.findings.map((finding, idx) => (
                                <div
                                  key={idx}
                                  className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs"
                                >
                                  <div className="flex items-start md:items-center gap-3">
                                    {getSeverityBadge(finding.severity)}
                                    <span className="font-mono text-zinc-300 font-semibold">
                                      [{finding.rule}]
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="text-zinc-200 font-sans">
                                      {finding.desc}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>

                                  <div className="font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-black/60 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-white/5 text-[11px] shrink-0 self-start md:self-auto">
                                    {finding.file}:{finding.line}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </React.Fragment>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Verification Modal */}
      {selectedVerification && (
        <VerificationModal
          isOpen={!!selectedVerification}
          onClose={() => setSelectedVerification(null)}
          entryName={selectedVerification.name}
          evidence={selectedVerification.evidence}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Terminal, Shield, Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";

export const ReproducibilityEngine: React.FC = () => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const commandText = `pip install nti-scanner\nnti-scanner scan . --submit`;

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(commandText);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <section className="mt-20 w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto">
      <div className="relative rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.02] p-8 md:p-12 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Glow Effects */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-emerald-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-cyan-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400">
            <Shield className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
            The Reproducibility Engine
          </span>
        </div>

        <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight font-sans">
          Don&apos;t trust us. Verify it yourself.
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-3 text-zinc-400 text-sm md:text-base leading-relaxed max-w-2xl font-sans">
          Every score on this board is backed by a cryptographic attestation. We don&apos;t guess.
          We parse the AST and generate offline-verifiable post-quantum attestations.
        </p>

        {/* Terminal Snippet */}
        <div className="mt-8 rounded-2xl bg-[#09090b] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-white/[0.03] border-b border-white/10">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Terminal className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400" />
              <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400">
                terminal — local verification
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-mono"
            >
              {copied ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span className="text-emerald-400">Copied</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Copy</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="p-5 font-mono text-xs md:text-sm text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed overflow-x-auto select-all">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-500 mb-1">
              <span># 1. Install the official NTI static analyzer</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
              <span className="text-zinc-500 select-none">$ </span>pip install nti-scanner
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-500 mt-4 mb-1">
              <span># 2. Run local AST scan and generate cryptographic proof</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
              <span className="text-zinc-500 select-none">$ </span>nti-scanner scan . --submit
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/VerificationModal.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, Copy, ShieldCheck, X, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { Evidence } from "@/types/leaderboard";

interface VerificationModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  entryName: string;
  evidence: Evidence;
}

export const VerificationModal: React.FC<VerificationModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  entryName,
  evidence,
}) => {
  const [copiedHash, setCopiedHash] = useState(false);
  const [copiedSig, setCopiedSig] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleCopyHash = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(evidence.attestationHash);
    setCopiedHash(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedHash(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleCopySig = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(evidence.signature);
    setCopiedSig(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedSig(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md transition-opacity">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl rounded-2xl bg-[#09090b] border border-white/10 p-6 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs">
        {/* Ambient Glow background */}
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -left-24 w-48 h-48 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -right-24 w-48 h-48 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white font-sans tracking-wide">
              Attestation Verification
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status Badge Banner */}
        <div className="my-5 p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 flex items-center gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <div>
            <div className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold font-sans">
              Cryptographically Verified via NTI-Registry
            </div>
            <div className="text-zinc-400 text-[11px] font-sans mt-0.5">
              Target Framework: <span className="text-white font-mono">{entryName}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Attestation Details */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1 text-zinc-400">
              <span className="text-[11px]">Attestation Hash (SHA-256)</span>
              <button
                onClick={handleCopyHash}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
              >
                <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                {copiedHash ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/60 border border-white/5 text-zinc-300 break-all select-all font-mono text-[11px]">
              {evidence.attestationHash}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1 text-zinc-400">
              <span className="text-[11px]">Post-Quantum Signature (ML-DSA-5)</span>
              <button
                onClick={handleCopySig}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
              >
                <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                {copiedSig ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/60 border border-white/5 text-zinc-300 break-all select-all font-mono text-[11px]">
              {evidence.signature}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 font-sans border-t border-white/5">
            <div>
              Scanner Engine: <span className="text-zinc-300 font-mono">{evidence.scannerVersion}</span>
            </div>
            <a
              href="https://github.com"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-400 hover:underline"
            >
              Verify on Chain/Registry <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

================================================
FILE: src/types/leaderboard.ts
================================================
export type Severity = "Critical" | "High" | "Moderate" | "Low" | "Info";

export interface Finding {
  rule: string;
  severity: Severity;
  desc: string;
  file: string;
  line: number;
}

export interface Evidence {
  attestationHash: string;
  signature: string;
  scannerVersion: string;
}

export interface Trend {
  previousScore: number;
  delta: number;
}

export type Status = "Verified" | "Pending" | "Failing";

export interface LeaderboardEntry {
  rank: number;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  score: number;
  grade: string;
  status: Status;
  lastScanned: string;
  trend: Trend | null;
  evidence: Evidence;
  findings: Finding[];
}

export interface LeaderboardData {
  source: string;
  generatedAt: string;
  rubricVersion: string;
  entries: LeaderboardEntry[];
}
